name: Kagi yin-yang thickness flip
note: Builds a Kagi line from closes with a reversal amount of kg_mult ATRs, fixed at each session open. Turning points give shoulders and waists; the line's thickness state goes yang above the last shoulder and yin below the last waist and persists until the opposite condition fires. Entry is on the state flip, optionally only when the immediately preceding counter-swing was shallower than the median of its own recent distribution - sellers unable to force a full-sized retracement before buyers reclaimed the prior high. Exit on the flip back.
source: Kagi construction and the yin/yang (thick/thin) shoulder-waist rules: Steve Nison, 'Beyond Candlesticks' (Wiley, 1994), Kagi chapter. Empirical work on Kagi in a systematic context: 'Performance of Pairs Trading Strategies Based on Renko and Kagi Charts' (2025), DOI 10.33138/2957-0506.2025.20.483. The shallow-preceding-swing filter is the harvester's synthesis.
